confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Vientiane price levels, not from live listings or inspected booking pages. Restaurant and café anchors are the more reliable; accommodation and the wine and cocktail anchors are less certain. Prices are typically set in LAK and converted to USD at a rate that moves over time, so USD values carry extra uncertainty. Wine and cocktail anchors use the local beer and restaurant price relationship as the basis because direct knowledge is weak.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Southeast Asian mid-sized capitals with similar tourism and restaurant pricing, such as Phnom Penh and Luang Prabang, scaled to Vientiane's price level, which is generally below Bangkok and above rural Laos.
